title: Identity Platform — Product-Facing Principal Contract (v1, FROZEN)
description: The stable shape a product receives after validating an Identity-Platform-issued access token — mirrors IdentityPrincipal (src/contracts/identity-principal.contract.ts), itself a type alias of AuthenticatedExternalPrincipal. This is NOT the raw JWT claim set (see access-token-claims-v1.schema.json) — it is the constructed, in-memory principal object a resource server's own validation pipeline produces after signature/issuer/audience/temporal verification.

principalType.description: REQUIRED. Never inferred from principalId's shape/format.

principalId.description: REQUIRED. The token's own verified sub claim.

tenantId.description: REQUIRED. Authoritative. Never overridden by a client-supplied header/parameter.

organizationId.description: OPTIONAL. USER only — null (tenant-wide) or a validated organization id. Absent for SERVICE_ACCOUNT.

clientId.description: REQUIRED. The registered Application this token was issued to.

scopes.description: REQUIRED (may be empty array). Never itself an IAM permission — see docs/PRODUCT_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md §5.

x-construction-rule: The contract must not expose Prisma entities directly — every field above is copied from the already-verified AuthenticatedExternalPrincipal, never a live/re-fetched database row (docs/RESOURCE_SERVER_ARCHITECTURE.md: 'no database lookups on every JWT validation').
